| **DataForSEO** | Bulk data extraction & full SEO toolsets | Usage-based (~$0.60 to $2.00 / 1k) | Asynchronous bulk processing; pairs SERP data with backlogs and keyword research. |
| **SearchApi** | Multi-engine search + modern AI surfaces | $40 / month | Tracks standard engines alongside AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, and Perplexity. |
| **Bright Data / Oxylabs** | Enterprise-grade reliability and massive scale | Pay-as-you-go / Custom (~$1.50/1k) | Built on world-class proxy infrastructure with near-100% success rates, advanced geolocation, and robust compliance features. |
| **Scrapingdog** | High-speed scraping on a budget | $40 / month | Frequently benchmarks as one of the fastest response times for structured Google SERP extraction. |

### Recommendations by Use Case

* **For building AI Agents or RAG pipelines:** Go with **Serper** for clean, low-latency JSON delivery, or **SearchApi** if you need visibility into modern generative search engines.
* **For traditional SEO & Rank Tracking:** Choose **SerpApi** for unmatched regional accuracy and historical data, or **DataForSEO** if you are pulling millions of keywords at scale.
* **For Enterprise Applications:** Opt for **Bright Data** or **Oxylabs** to handle strict anti-bot measures, complex geolocation targeting, and heavy concurrent requests.
